He was particularly effective from beyond the arc, knocking down four triples while shooting 50 percent from the field. Despite the narrow defeat, Brunson delivered another strong fantasy performance, combining efficient scoring with elite facilitating.

news.headline: Jalen Brunson lets the Pacers' bench hear if after a nasty bucket
Brunson tallied 23 points (7-18 FG, 1-3 3Pt, 8-8 FT), four rebounds and two assists across 28 minutes in Tuesday's 117-85 win over the Bucks.
news.story: Brunson led New York in scoring despite struggling with his shot, and it was far from the star playmaker's best performance. He also posted pedestrian numbers in rebounds and assists, with no defensive stats. The Knicks limited Brunson to just 28 minutes because of the blowout, but expect the reigning Finals MVP to be more involved moving forward. He has scored at least 30 points in three of his last six appearances.

news.story: Daniels didn't miss a shot from the field and filled the stat sheet again, extending his league lead in steals per game. His rebounding and playmaking keep growing, which makes him far more than a steals specialist in fantasy. His limited shot volume is the only thing holding back his ceiling.

news.headline: Daniels accumulated nine points (4-9 FG, 1-2 FT), 10 rebounds, seven assists, one block and six steals over 31 minutes during Saturday's 124-121 victory over the Nets.
news.story: Daniels was a beast on both ends of the floor, nudging a rare quadruple-double despite scoring just nine points. Although his offensive output has been somewhat underwhelming, Daniels' contributions across the board have been ultra effective. Look for him to continue racking up the stats when Atlanta hosts the Lakers on Monday.

news.headline: Daniels finished Friday's 139-132 victory over Washington with 13 points (6-9 FG, 0-1 3Pt, 1-1 FT), nine rebounds, 12 assists and two steals across 34 minutes.
news.story: Daniels fell one rebound short of a triple-double, including a season-high 12 assists. While the steals have been relatively consistent, Daniels has been a beast on the glass over the past three games, averaging 11.3 rebounds during that span. He has been a top-50 player thus far this season, averaging 9.9 points, 6.9 rebounds, 5.3 assists and 2.6 steals in 30.1 minutes per game.

news.headline: Jalen Brunson lets the Pacers' bench hear if after a nasty bucket

news.story: Brunson led New York in scoring despite struggling with his shot, and it was far from the star playmaker's best performance. He also posted pedestrian numbers in rebounds and assists, with no defensive stats. The Knicks limited Brunson to just 28 minutes because of the blowout, but expect the reigning Finals MVP to be more involved moving forward. He has scored at least 30 points in three of his last six appearances.

news.headline: Sexton (head) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Suns, Daniel Starkand of LakersNation.com reports.
news.story: Sexton was a full participant in Saturday's practice, and while the questionable tag indicates some caution, he's trending in the right direction and could be available Sunday. The veteran has been putting up solid numbers of late, scoring in double digits in all but one of his last five appearances and averaging 11.0 points, 1.6 rebounds and 2.6 assists per game in that span.

news.headline: Sexton (head) was a full participant in Saturday's practice, Dave McMenamin of ESPN.com reports.
news.story: Sexton left Wednesday's game against Milwaukee early after bumping heads with Ryan Rollins and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead. However, Sexton escaped the incident without a concussion, and his ability to practice without restraint is a positive sign for his availability Sunday against the Suns.

news.headline: Sexton did not return to Wednesday's 123-112 win over the Bucks and required stitches to close a cut on his forehead, Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times reports.
news.story: Sexton knocked noggins with Ryan Rollins, but it sounds like he's avoided a concussion, so he should be able to get out there for Sunday's game in Phoenix. Austin Reaves (heel) also exited Wednesday's game, and if he needs to sit out Sunday, Sexton would have the chance for some extended minutes.
